options.content:
### When will each compactor be full?
An estimate from the filling speed since the last emptying, in site time: in fast demo mode 1 real minute is 1 site hour.

**Real** = recorded by the system · **Estimated** = calculated with placeholder prices or factors · **Simulated** = not from physical hardware or a real operator

panels.title: Where the weights on this page come from

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'No readings yet'
  WHEN bool_and(coalesce(edge_quality, '') = 'simulated') THEN 'SIMULATED: made-up demo history, no device connected'
  WHEN bool_or(seq IS NOT NULL) THEN 'SIMULATED load cell: real ESP32 edge processing, no physical sensor yet'
  ELSE 'SOURCE NOT VERIFIED: readings without a device counter' END AS "Source"
FROM (SELECT edge_quality, seq FROM tenant_api.readings ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100) r

SELECT c.name AS "Compactor", s.load_pct AS "Full %", c.on_call_threshold_pct AS "Truck ordered at %",
  s.hours_to_full AS "Full in site hours (estimate)"
FROM tenant_api.compactors c JOIN tenant_api.compactor_status s ON s.compactor_id = c.id WHERE c.id IN ($device) ORDER BY s.hours_to_full NULLS LAST

SELECT r.ts AS "time", r.compactor_id AS metric, round(greatest(r.weight_kg / c.capacity_kg * 100, coalesce(r.fill_pct, 0))::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM tenant_api.readings r JOIN tenant_api.compactors c ON c.id = r.compactor_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.compactor_id IN ($device) ORDER BY 1
